1.1: From the elder— To my dear brother Gaius, the one I truly love in the truth:
1.2: Beloved, I'm prayin' that everything's goin' well with you—that you prosper in every area and stay healthy, just like your soul's already thriving. ✨
1.3: I was real glad when some folks came through and told me you still solid in the truth—livin' it, not just knowin' it.
1.4: Ain't nothin' make me happier than hearin' that my spiritual kids are walkin' in truth. That's the real flex.
1.5: My beloved, you been faithful in how you treat the fam—and even folks you ain't know like that.
1.6: They already testified to your love in front of the whole church. When you help them out on their journey, representin' God right, you doin' a good thing.
1.7: They out here servin' for the sake of the Name—they ain't takin' help from the outside world.
1.8: So we need to support people like that—'cause when we do, we teamin' up with the truth. 💯
1.9: I tried to write to the church, but Diotrephes—the dude who always wanna be "top dog"—he ain't tryna hear from us.
1.10: So when I come through, I'ma bring it up. He been talkin' reckless about us, spreadin' mess. And not only that—he refuses to welcome the brothers, and blocks others from showin' love too. Even kicks folks out the church for it. 🥴
1.11: Beloved, don't follow evil—follow good. If you do good, you from God. If you do evil, you ain't never seen Him.
1.12: Now Demetrius? Solid dude. Everybody speak well of him—even the truth itself backs him up. We vouch for him too, and you know we ain't gotta lie.
1.13: I got a lot more I could write, but I ain't tryna do it all with pen and ink.
1.14: I'm hopin' to pull up soon so we can talk face to face.
1.15: Peace to you. Our people send love. Show love to the crew—call 'em by name. 🫱🏾‍🫲🏽
